messages.author: c6dd56176166e4bb
messages.subject: error MSstats TMT
parts:
Dear MSstats developers,

I am trying to use the MSstatsTMT to analyze da data, however, I am getting an error in the generation of input.maxquant file:
> input.maxquant <- MaxQtoMSstatsTMTFormat(evidence=evi, + annotation=annotation, + proteinGroups=proteinGroups) ** + Contaminant, + Reverse, + Only.identified.by.site, proteins are removed. Error in `[.data.frame`(proteinGroups, , c("Protein.IDs", "id")) : undefined columns selected

I recently analyzed similar data, and I never got this error before. Please, what am I doing wrong?

Thank you so much for your attention,

Best,
Debora
